capabilities: collapse sidebars by clicking note content
expand sidebars by clicking the ribbon blank area
expand sidebars by clicking the note title
extras: The README references a demo whose media is not included; it lists optional settings for how sidebars expand.
intentEvidence: This plugin enables you to collapse (and expand) the sidebar easier.
motivation: The README says it makes collapsing and expanding the sidebar easier, but gives no further motivation.
problem: Obsidian sidebars must be toggled manually, which gets in the way when working in the editor.
summary: Sidebar manager that collapses sidebars when you click the editor and can expand them via ribbon or title clicks.
